response.sql: SELECT s.entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount, AVG(e.imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(e2.imgcount) FROM scanenvironment e2 JOIN sites s2 ON s2.zoneregistry = e2.zoneref) AS avg_imgcount_minus_overall FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = e.zoneref GROUP BY s.entrystat

assumptions.assumption: The overall average image count is the average of imgcount over all environment records that match a site (inner join), computed per record and ignoring NULLs, not an average of the per-status averages.
Sites with a NULL entrystat, if any, form their own group (a NULL status row), since the request does not say to drop them.
